task: Cleaning a soap dish in the shower
query: How do I clean a soap dish in the shower?

goal.title: Clean and remount the shower soap holder
goal.description: Remove the soap and suction-mounted wire holder, take the holder apart over the sink, scrub the mount and wire rack with a toothbrush and cleaning liquid, rinse and reassemble it, then dry and remount it.
goal.final_state: The cleaned holder is attached to the shower tile and the blue soap is back on the rack.
procedure: Move the soap to the sink and loosen the holder from the shower tile.
Rinse and inspect the holder, then prepare the toothbrush with cleaning liquid.
Scrub the circular mount and detached wire rack, including edges and wire joints.
Rinse the rack and mount, reassemble the holder, and dry it with the blue cloth.
Wipe the mounting area, secure the holder on the tile, and replace the soap.

phases.description: The soap is moved to the sink, the holder is loosened from the tile, and the assembly is inspected and rinsed over the basin.
The toothbrush is wetted and cleaning liquid squeezed onto its bristles, then it is transferred to the working hand.
The toothbrush scrubs around the metal mounting housing; the circular suction mount is detached and its inner and outer surfaces brushed.
The rack is turned through different orientations while the toothbrush works along the bars, rim, ends, and joints.
The faucet is adjusted, the rack and mount rubbed under running water, and the mounting assembly reattached to the rack.
The holder is dried with the blue cloth, the tile mounting area wiped, the suction assembly secured, and the soap returned.
